diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~20% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.045), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w7' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9667. Series context: trend strength 0.9991 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.045); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.604.
